basic_identification.full_title: Specification for Jig Foot Bolts (जिग फुट बोल्ट की विशिष्टि)
basic_identification.sector_category: Production and General Engineering / Machine Tools, Machine Tool Elements, and Holding Devices (approved by the Production and General Engineering Division Council and finalized by the Machine Tools, Machine Tool Elements, and Holding Devices Sectional Committee, PGD 35, under the Bureau of Indian Standards)

sectional_committee.name: Machine Tools, Machine Tool Elements, and Holding Devices Sectional Committee

scope.summary: This Indian Standard prescribes the standardized physical dimensions, thread parameters, materials, hardness, and general requirements for jig foot bolts (clamping support and leveling bolts) used in workholding assemblies, jigs, and fixtures. These bolts act as stable legs or feet on the base of drilling jigs or milling fixtures to provide a robust, elevated, and leveled seating surface on machine tool tables, compensating for uneven castings or surface variations.

requirements.detail: Observed or calculated final test values, thicknesses, angles, and tolerances must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2:1960. The decimal places retained should match that of the specified value in the standard.
Specifies dimensions and other requirements for jig foot bolts to be used with jigs and fixtures conforming to standard tooling practices.

The bolt body must be manufactured from high-grade medium carbon steel or low-alloy steel wire featuring mechanical properties conforming to Property Class 8.8 (tensile strength of 800 N/mm² and yield strength of 640 N/mm²) to prevent structural shear.
The bolt must feature a smooth, uniform black oxide chemical finish (or zinc plating) to resist corrosion from cutting coolants, humidity, and active industrial environments.

Specifies metric thread sizes (M8, M10, M12, M16, and M20) held to a 6g tolerance class fit to prevent loose play or thread jamming inside tapped holes or matching jig foot nuts (conforming to IS 11843). Lengths typically range from 30 mm to 100 mm.
Features a radius-head (or flat-head) contact surface with a hexagonal socket drive (allen-drive) or integrated hex collar, allowing toolmakers to adjust heights easily on-site.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 11831 : 1986 (Reaffirmed 2022) is the primary national Indian Standard specification prescribing quality requirements, material properties, hardness limits, and nominal dimensions for jig foot bolts (leveling and support bolts) used in jigs and fixtures. Maintained under the Machine Tools, Machine Tool Elements, and Holding Devices Sectional Committee (PGD 35), the standard unifies tool designs used to support, elevate, and level machining fixtures on machine tool tables. It standardizes metric thread sizes (M8 to M20) held to a 6g class fit and untoleranced dimensions under the Medium tolerance class of IS 2102. By requiring through-hardened medium carbon steel (Property Class 8.8) with a rust-resistant black oxide finish, the standard ensures that jig foot bolts withstand high clamping pressures and severe milling vibrations without shearing, supporting standardized on-site industrial quality control.
